Ask a question out loud and the evidence appears while the conversation is still happening.

The problem

Why does the answer to “why did sales move?” always arrive after the meeting is over?

Thought process

The prototype runs in a browser on illustrative data. Joining Zoom or Teams and handling several speakers is the next step.

The solution

Meridian listens for the question and makes the answer the main thing on screen: one big number, a trend or a table. Follow-ups reuse the current metric and dates, so the discussion keeps moving.
